digest.component_or_area: overlap judge / plan review advisory classifier
propositions: Batched overlap-judge calls inherited generic 16,000-token output and 600-second timeout budgets without operation-local ceilings, causing three sequential structured-generation retries on malformed candidate_id responses that consumed 216–311 seconds before safe abstention.

RunRequest lacks per-request seams for structured-output retry count, transport-attempt count, and request timeout, forcing all callers through generic policy that permits multiple full generations and retries.

Token-output capping alone does not prevent retry loops; schema validation alone executes only after malformed payload fully exists; both together with retry suppression are necessary for prompt abstention.

The overlap-judge advisory contract (story 9022 and ADR 0086) requires bounded operation with timeout/error/malformed-output degrading promptly to all-candidate abstention, violated by current multi-minute, multiply-retried behavior.

Repair adds lowering-only seams to RunRequest (output_token_limit, structured_retry_max, transport_attempt_max, timeout_s) and applies them in _effective_config before model construction, then assigns overlap-judge explicit budgets: 1,024 tokens, one structured attempt, one transport attempt, 60-second timeout.

Valid verdict demultiplexing, label-keyed mapping, and aggregation behavior must be preserved byte-for-byte; existing callers omitting limits retain current defaults; only judge_batch is affected behind the public overlap_findings entry point.
